turns.speaker: DET
turns.text: Okay, Calvin. This is Detective Rowe. We're recording this, and you're free to leave at any time. Do you understand?

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: Yeah, I understand.

turns.speaker: DET
turns.text: Tell me where you were last Thursday night.

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: I was home most of the night. Then I went out for a drive because I couldn't sleep.

turns.speaker: DET
turns.text: Where did you drive?

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: Just around town. Down Harbor Street, past the marina.

turns.speaker: DET
turns.text: Harbor Street. That's where the pharmacy is. Somebody broke into it that night.

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: I heard about that. I don't know anything about it.

turns.speaker: DET
turns.text: What time were you out driving?

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: Late. It was around two in the morning, I think.

turns.speaker: DET
turns.text: We know the back door was pried open with a crowbar. Do you own a crowbar, Calvin?

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.speaker: DET
turns.text: Where is it now?

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: In my garage, I guess. I use it for work.

turns.speaker: DET
turns.text: The pharmacy has an alarm. It never went off. Why do you think that is?

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: Maybe somebody cut the wire. That's what people do, right? You cut the alarm wire first.

turns.speaker: DET
turns.text: That's an interesting thing to say. Nobody told you about the alarm wire.

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: I'm just guessing. I watch a lot of crime shows.

turns.speaker: DET
turns.text: A neighbor saw a white pickup truck parked behind the store. You drive a white pickup, don't you?

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: Yeah, I do. But lots of people have white trucks.

turns.speaker: DET
turns.text: And the camera across the street shows a man carrying a gray backpack.

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: I have a gray backpack. Everybody has a gray backpack.

turns.speaker: DET
turns.text: The cash drawer was left open. Did you open the cash drawer?

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: No. I never touched any drawer. I wasn't in there.

turns.speaker: DET
turns.text: Calvin, it will go a lot easier if you're honest with me.

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: I am being honest. I drove around and I went home.

turns.speaker: DET
turns.text: Okay. We'll take a break here. It's three fifteen in the afternoon.

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: Can I get some water?
